review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Nowadays, an increasing number of ppl are concerned about the problem that whether advertising has positive economic affect economic positively or has detrimental effects on society by making them dissatisfied. Although I accept that ads are fostering economic development, I also argue that those can create unrealistic expectations to people.

On one hand, one might argue that advertising undoubtedly bring lots of economic benefits. These sales tools often come along with creative content and appealing visual effects, which stimulating consumer's demand and increase the spending power. As a result, more production are encouraged to buy, creating a big opportunity for the state to fostering revenues through taxation. For example, e-commerce platforms such as: Shopee or Lazada in VN are heavily rely on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Additionally, advertising also creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

On the other hand, ppl also cite that advertising has negative social consequences. The chief among those is that in today's digital age, companies constantly show images e.g. perfect lifestyles or luxury standards and from that drive consumers' interest. For instance, young ppl often feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok, thereby this can lead to frustration when they can't afford them. Another flaw is that ads can promote materialistic values, which can negatively affect young generations' awareness and be a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, advertising has both positive economic effects and negative social impacts. To solve this problem, we can regulate advertising content to maximize its benefits while minimize its drawbacks.

completion.comment: Đã đối chiếu trực tiếp toàn bộ trang 5–6 của PDF gốc; bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần và bám đúng hai hướng của đề, nhưng bài còn ẩu và khâu tự soát chưa nghiêm túc. Lỗi xuất hiện dày ở từ loại, dạng động từ, chủ ngữ–động từ, từ thay thế và cách nối chuỗi. Hai Body chưa mượn lời đúng phe theo khung Buổi 27; Body 1 bị đứt logic ở “more production are encouraged to buy”, Body 2 tách sai materialism thành một ý mới, còn kết bài đưa thêm giải pháp chưa được phát triển. Em cần sửa và viết lại toàn bài theo khung Cô đã dạy.

learningCriteria.label: Dàn ý
learningCriteria.comment: Bài có đủ bốn đoạn và hai view, nhưng Introduction chưa chốt bằng khung “There are strong cases...”, hai Body chưa quy lời cho hai phe cụ thể và Conclusion thêm giải pháp mới ngoài dàn ý.
evidence: Nowadays, an increasing number of ppl are concerned about the problem that whether advertising has positive economic affect economic positively or has detrimental effects on society by making them dissatisfied. Although I accept that ads are fostering economic development, I also argue that those can create unrealistic expectations to people.
Overall, advertising has both positive economic effects and negative social impacts. To solve this problem, we can regulate advertising content to maximize its benefits while minimize its drawbacks.
learningCriteria.action: Viết lại Introduction–hai câu chủ đề–Conclusion thành một hệ thống đúng khung Buổi 27.

learningCriteria.label: Lập luận
learningCriteria.comment: Em có demand, Shopee/Lazada, jobs, pressure và materialism, nhưng các mắt xích bị sai chủ thể hoặc tách rời: production không thể buy, còn materialism phải là kết quả dài hạn của áp lực và frustration.
evidence: more production are encouraged to buy
Another flaw is that ads can promote materialistic values
learningCriteria.action: Nối lại Body 1 theo demand → production → tax/jobs và Body 2 theo ideal images → dissatisfaction → pressure → frustration → materialism.

learningCriteria.label: Ngôn ngữ
learningCriteria.comment: Bài dùng nhiều dạng viết tắt và cụm thiếu tự nhiên như ppl, ads, e.g., lots of, cite that, luxury standards; đây là dấu hiệu em chưa tự soát theo quy tắc văn phong vừa học.
learningCriteria.action: Bỏ toàn bộ viết tắt, dùng động từ tường thuật và collocation đúng nghĩa.

learningCriteria.label: Liên kết
learningCriteria.comment: Cặp On the one hand/On the other hand bị sai dạng ở Body 1; one might argue không xác định phe; those, from that và thereby this không giữ được chủ thể và quan hệ kết quả rõ ràng.
evidence: On one hand, one might argue that
learningCriteria.action: Mỗi câu nối phải cho biết phe nào đang nói, chủ thể nào thực hiện và câu sau là nguyên nhân hay kết quả của câu trước.

learningCriteria.label: Độ chính xác
learningCriteria.comment: Lỗi nền tảng lặp ở nhiều câu: advertising bring, which stimulating, production are, to fostering, are heavily rely và while minimize. Với mật độ này, bài chưa cho thấy khâu tự soát nghiêm túc.
learningCriteria.action: Viết lại toàn bài rồi rà riêng từng động từ, chủ ngữ, dạng sau to/while và danh từ số ít–số nhiều.

cohesionAudit.label: Trình tự đoạn
evidence: Nowadays, an increasing number of ppl are concerned about the problem that whether advertising has positive economic affect economic positively or has detrimental effects on society by making them dissatisfied. Although I accept that ads are fostering economic development, I also argue that those can create unrealistic expectations to people.
Overall, advertising has both positive economic effects and negative social impacts. To solve this problem, we can regulate advertising content to maximize its benefits while minimize its drawbacks.
cohesionAudit.comment: Trật tự Introduction → lợi ích kinh tế → hệ quả xã hội → Conclusion có mặt, nhưng Introduction chưa chốt đúng khung hai phía và Conclusion chuyển sang regulation, làm chức năng đoạn cuối lệch khỏi hai Body.
cohesionAudit.action: Chốt both sides ở Introduction; Conclusion chỉ xác nhận cả hai view và tóm tắt economic development cùng social dissatisfaction.

cohesionAudit.label: Câu chủ đề và phần hỗ trợ
evidence: On one hand, one might argue that advertising undoubtedly bring lots of economic benefits.
On the other hand, ppl also cite that advertising has negative social consequences.
cohesionAudit.comment: Hai câu đều bao quát đúng positive economic effects và negative social consequences, nên không thiếu câu chủ đề. Vấn đề là cả hai chưa mượn lời đúng phe theo khung Buổi 27 và câu Body 1 còn sai động từ.
cohesionAudit.action: Giữ phạm vi hai câu nhưng đổi thành supporters of advertising và those on the other side of the debate.

cohesionAudit.label: Logic giữa các câu
evidence: As a result, more production are encouraged to buy
advertised on TikTok, thereby this can lead to frustration
cohesionAudit.comment: As a result báo kết quả nhưng đặt production làm chủ thể buy nên chuỗi demand → production → tax bị đứt. Thereby this can lead cũng ghép sai cấu trúc kết quả sau ví dụ TikTok.
cohesionAudit.action: Viết firms increase production và dùng leading to frustration để giữ đúng quan hệ nguyên nhân–kết quả.

cohesionAudit.label: Chuyển ý
evidence: Additionally, advertising also creates jobs in marketing, media and design
Another flaw is that ads can promote materialistic values
cohesionAudit.comment: Body 1 có dấu hiệu chuyển sang cơ chế việc làm nhưng Additionally + also bị lặp. Body 2 là một chuỗi duy nhất, nên Another flaw tách materialism thành lý do thứ hai trái dàn ý.
cohesionAudit.action: Dùng Furthermore một lần ở Body 1; ở Body 2 nối materialism bằng In the long run, this pressure can....

cohesionAudit.label: Quy chiếu và thay thế
cohesionAudit.comment: Those ở Introduction và Body 2 không có danh từ rõ; These sales tools tự tạo một nhãn mới cho advertising nên chủ thể thay đổi không cần thiết.
cohesionAudit.action: Lặp advertising/advertising campaigns và gọi rõ these consequences khi cần thay thế.

pairedContrast.comment: Hai Body thực sự đối lập đúng chức năng, nhưng vế đầu thiếu the nên cặp chưa đúng dạng.
Vế Body 2 đúng dạng nhưng đang ghép với vế Body 1 thiếu the; cần sửa cả cặp cho nhất quán.

borrowedVoice.quote: one might argue that advertising undoubtedly bring lots of economic benefits
borrowedVoice.comment: One might argue là mượn lời, nhưng one không xác định người nói thuộc phe ủng hộ quảng cáo. Buổi 27 yêu cầu gọi rõ supporters/advocates of advertising.

borrowedVoice.comment: Ppl also cite that vừa chung chung vừa dùng sai động từ tường thuật; chưa xác định đây là phía phản đối quảng cáo hoặc phía còn lại của tranh luận.

annotations.title: Viết tắt
annotations.explanation: Trong bài học thuật, em không dùng ppl. Đây là dạng viết tắt không phù hợp với văn phong bài luận; cần viết đầy đủ people.

annotations.title: Cấu trúc gián tiếp
annotations.explanation: Sau concerned about, em có thể đưa trực tiếp mệnh đề whether. Cụm the problem that whether chồng hai cấu trúc và làm câu sai.

annotations.quote: has positive economic affect economic positively
annotations.errorTypeLabel: Từ loại và diễn đạt lặp
annotations.title: Từ loại và diễn đạt lặp
annotations.explanation: Affect thường là động từ, còn đề đang cần danh từ effects. Economic và economically positively còn lặp cùng một ý, nên cụm này phải trở về positive economic effects.

annotations.title: Quy chiếu không rõ
annotations.explanation: Them đứng sau society nên người đọc có thể hiểu sai đối tượng. Đề nói people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have; em cần nêu rõ people hoặc viết lại toàn cụm.

annotations.title: Viết tắt
annotations.explanation: Ads là cách rút gọn thường gặp nhưng bài luyện yêu cầu văn phong học thuật đầy đủ. Dùng advertising khi nói chung về hoạt động quảng cáo.

annotations.title: Thì và thể
annotations.explanation: Đây là nhận định chung về tác động của advertising, không phải một hành động tạm thời đang diễn ra. Dùng hiện tại đơn fosters.

annotations.title: Từ thay thế không rõ
annotations.explanation: Those không có danh từ số nhiều rõ ràng để quy chiếu và không phù hợp khi em đang nói về advertising. Lặp lại advertising giúp giữ đúng chủ thể.

annotations.title: Giới từ
annotations.explanation: Trong nghĩa tạo ra những kỳ vọng đối với con người, expectations đi với for people, không đi với to people.

annotations.quote: Although I accept that ads are fostering economic development, I also argue that those can create unrealistic expectations to people.

annotations.title: Cặp đối lập
annotations.explanation: Cặp chuẩn là On the one hand và On the other hand. Em thiếu the ở vế đầu nên cặp liên kết giữa hai Body chưa đúng dạng.

annotations.explanation: Come along with không tự nhiên khi mô tả đặc điểm của một chiến dịch. Feature diễn đạt đúng việc chiến dịch có nội dung sáng tạo và hiệu ứng hấp dẫn.

annotations.explanation: Consumer demand là cụm danh từ cố định nói về nhu cầu của người tiêu dùng nói chung. Consumer's demand chỉ nhu cầu của một người tiêu dùng cụ thể.

paragraphs: Nowadays, an increasing number of people are concerned about whether advertising has positive economic effects or causes negative social consequences by making people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the substantial economic benefits it can bring. Advertising campaigns often feature creative content and appealing visual effects, which stimulate consumer demand and increase consumer spending. As a result, greater demand encourages firms to increase production, creating opportunities for the state to generate revenue through taxation. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising has negative social consequences. Chief among these consequences is the constant display of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions in today's digital age, which can create unrealistic expectations and dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok, leading to frustration when they cannot afford them. In the long run, this pressure can shape the attitudes of younger generations, promote materialistic values and foster a money-driven culture.
In conclusion, I believe both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising can foster economic development while also contributing to social dissatisfaction.

paragraphs: In today's society, news media play an increasingly important role in people's daily lives. With the development of technology, people can access news more easily than ever before.

Admittedly, I believe that news media bring several negative impacts. One major reason is that people are constantly exposed to news through smartphones and the Internet. These technologies allow people to follow the news instantly no matter where they are or What time is it, making news consumption become a regular part of their routine. Furthermore, there is intense competition among news outlets to gain people's attention. As a result, media agencies often focus on shocking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner. Dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals are also be used to attract readers. Consequently, people will become more concerned and from that increase the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, it is important for we to understand about the benefits that news bring. Constant exposure to a stream of distressing and exaggerated news such as crime or political corruption may make people feel overly anxious or helpless, even when that do not directly affect them. Nevertheless, news coverage can warn the public to existing and looming problems in society. With people being informed, they will be more prepared to respond to potential threats and handle ricks in a complex society. For example, information about natural disaster can encourage ppl to take safety actions before it occurs.

In conclusion, I am convinced that news media may negatively affect people's lives, mainly because of the widespread use of technology items and the sensational presence of news. However, I believe that news can inform the public and raise awareness about existing concernings.

paragraphs: It is often argued that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others believe that students who show significant improvements should also be rewarded. Although rewarding top students can encourage competition, I believe that recognising students' progress is also important.

On the one hand, rewarding students who achieve the best academic results can encourage them to work harder for their studies. Students who have devoted a great deal of time and effort to their education deserve to receive praise and privileges. Such rewards may encourage other students to study harder in order to win similar rewards. As a result, this may create a competitive learning environment and help student to improve their overall academic performance. Furthermore, this kind of competition is present in many aspects of life, where only best individuals are rewarded. Therefore, students may become familiar with this reality, which could help them to face competition and achieve success in the future.

On the other hand, I believe that students who make progress should also be rewarded. If only a few smart students can receive the rewards, other stud[mất chữ ở mép ảnh] may feel that their efforts are pointles[mất chữ ở mép ảnh] because they can't surpass those outstand[mất chữ ở mép ảnh] individuals. This could make them feel overwhelmed and gradually lose the incentive to study. In contrast, rewarding improvem[mất chữ ở mép ảnh] can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve them[mất chữ ở mép ảnh]. For ex[không đọc rõ] A student who improves from an average result to a good one, even more beneficial than the competitive determination to win against others.

paragraphs: It is often argued that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others believe that students who show significant improvements should also be rewarded. Although rewarding top students can encourage competition, I believe that recognising students' progress is also important.

Admittedly, schools have sound reasons to reward students who achieve the best academic results. Chief of these reasons is that students who have devoted a great deal of time and effort to their education deserve to receive praise and privileges. Such rewards may encourage other students to study harder in order to win similar rewards. As a result, this may create a competitive learning environment and help students to improve their overall academic performance. Furthermore, this kind of competition is present in many aspects of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Therefore, students may become familiar with this reality, which could help them to face competition and achieve success in the future.

However, I believe that students who make progress should also be rewarded. The key reason is that if only a few smart students can receive the rewards, other students may feel that their efforts are pointless. This is because they may feel unable to surpass those outstanding students. This could make them feel overwhelmed and gradually lose the incentive to study. In contrast, rewarding improvement can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves. For example, a student who improves from an average result to a good one shows that self-improvement may be more beneficial than the competitive determination to win against others.
In conclusion, although rewarding students with the highest scores can encourage competition and motivate them to study harder, I believe that recognising students' progress is also important.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
